fusions.name: Branching Reef
fusions.desc: Drives the haft down and coral branches up around you, dealing 10 piercing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Speared from the Shoal
fusions.desc: Hurls the coral-tipped polearm into the first enemy within 7 tiles for 20 water damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Polyp Garden
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and grows a reef around it for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Growth on the Wreck
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
